transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi. Well, I guess what really pushed me to come in is that... lately, every time a door slams at work, or if someone rolls a suitcase fast across the lobby, I just jump. It's like it’s happening again. And then it takes me a good minute just to get my heart back down. It's just been really hard to deal with.
When you mention feeling like 'it’s happening again,' what specific experience or event are you being reminded of?

Well, about two weeks ago, a guest threatened me at the front desk. It got pretty aggressive. So, that's what I'm being reminded of. This whole thing has been going on for about two weeks now, basically ever since that happened.
During that encounter, did you feel your life was in danger, or were you threatened with serious physical harm?

Yeah, he... he said he was going to come across the counter and beat the living hell out of me. He was screaming it right in my face. So, yeah, I definitely felt like I was about to be seriously hurt. I didn't know if he had a weapon or what he was going to do.
Have you been trying to avoid the front desk, certain guests, or anything else that reminds you of that encounter?

Yeah, I have. Actually, I’ve been taking the back hallway at work whenever I can. Just... walking past that specific spot in the lobby where it happened makes my chest tighten up, and I just want to get away from it. So I try to avoid that area if I don't absolutely have to be there.
Have any of these symptoms been going on for more than a month?
No, not that long. Like I said before, it's just been about two weeks... basically since that guy threatened me.
